identified_as: Sharon Hill High School, Sharon Hill (Delaware Co.)

notes: Mascot Owls from the 1960s yearbooks; 1946 text also calls the team 'the Hillers'. Purple and gold from the school's own 1942 and 1946 yearbooks (not class colours).
evidence: e-yearbook.com OCR of Sharon Hill 'Owl' yearbooks: 1942 band 'resplendently attired in fine, new purple and gold uniforms'; 1946 band again in 'purple and gold uniforms', and football: opponents 'scoring upon the Purple and Gold' (the 'Hiller' team). Class colours (blue/white, maroon/silver, maroon/gold, royal blue/gold, green/white) vary by year and were ignored. Text only, no hex.

evidence: Keith Lindie archive video stills (Blossburg): 1997 royal-blue 'Panthers' sweatshirt in a school display case, blue-and-white pep rally and blue court striping in the North Penn gym; 1970s football in white jerseys. Blue and white confirmed; no clean graphic for a hex.
